title: Vanilla Drift Varity
description: Improve Minecraft without breaking the Vanilla version, exploring all the texture changes that the game allows.
body:
_The current version requires OptiFine or alternatively "[Fabulously Optimized Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)"._

Since I learned how to create texture packs, I always wanted to be able to use everything I made directly in my survival worlds. For a long time, this was a slow and impractical process… but never impossible.

This project was born with a clear goal: to bring together all the content that my community and I imagine and want to see inside Minecraft, while keeping the experience as close to vanilla as possible.

- A scythe? ✔
- Plushies? ✔
- New types of metals? ✔
- Trophies to show off your achievements? ✔

The idea is simple: if it can be imagined, it can be brought into the game. The content will continue to grow over time, adding new items, ideas, and improvements based on community feedback.

This isn’t just a texture pack — it’s a living project, designed to enrich the survival experience without breaking Minecraft’s core identity.

Some of these resources and ideas come from my work at [Crysis Studio](https://x.com/CrysisStudio), often related to special events or series.
